FIELDS.NAME: Guardian Detective Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Guardian Detective Services specializes in unarmed security guard services for commercial office buildings and residential apartments, ensuring a safe and secure environment for both businesses and families. Our operations include conducting security assessments, managing on-site security personnel, and implementing comprehensive security protocols. We prioritize compliance with local regulations by employing licensed and certified security professionals. Our team is trained to handle access control, surveillance monitoring, and emergency response, all while maintaining adherence to safety standards. Additionally, we offer security consulting to help clients mitigate risks and enhance their security measures.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: "Guardian Security Consulting LLC, located at 5678 Safety Drive, Springfield, IL 62704, which provides advisory services for risk assessments and security audits without direct physical security operations."
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a theft incident occurred at our main office location due to inadequate surveillance during off-hours, resulting in a loss of $1,500. The incident was reported to the local police, and the current status is that we are following up on potential recovery of lost items. Additionally, on 06/10/2022, minor equipment damages from a power surge led to a loss of $500; this event was resolved, and the equipment has since been replaced. Total loss amount: $2,000.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $5,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Type II, UL Listed Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Unarmed security patrol services for office buildings and residential complexes with monitored central alarm systems.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Guardian Detective Services does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our operations focus solely on unarmed security services and consulting without any involvement in hazardous material activities.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Guardian Detective Services does not sponsor any athletic teams, as our focus is solely on providing unarmed security services and consulting for commercial and residential properties.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by the designated compliance officer or risk manager within the organization.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Guardian Detective Services has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We adhere to strict hiring standards and compliance with regulations to ensure a reputable service.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Guardian Detective Services has not had any policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the prior three years. We maintain a good standing with our previous insurer and have consistently met all policy requirements.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Guardian Detective Services does not lease employees to or from other employers. We maintain our own licensed personnel for all security operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Guardian Detective Services carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and provide coverage for our employees. This policy is active and is integral to our commitment to workplace safety.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Guardian Detective Services owns and operates another business, Guardian Security Consulting LLC, which provides advisory services for risk assessments and security audits without direct physical security operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Guardian Detective Services does not have any other insurance policies with this company. Currently, our only active policy is GDS-2023-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Guardian Detective Services is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on providing unarmed security services and consulting.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Guardian Detective Services does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus exclusively on providing unarmed security services and consulting.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Guardian Detective Services has not had any foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens during the past five years. We maintain a solid financial position and comply with all financial obligations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Guardian Detective Services does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations strictly involve unarmed security services and consulting without handling such materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Guardian Detective Services does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations are focused solely on providing unarmed security services without involvement in high-risk activities.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Guardian Detective Services has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize strict compliance with hiring practices and conduct thorough background checks on all personnel.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Guardian Detective Services does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. Our operations adhere to all fire safety regulations and standards.
